FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 225
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/11/2026
Senate Bill 225 as introduced would decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund
by an estimated $1.9 million in Fiscal Year 2027 (for the partial, 3/4 fiscal year) and $2.6
million annually thereafter (full fiscal year) by exempting the first $5,000 of inactive duty
training pay received by an Alabama National Guard member beginning January 1, 2027.
